fixes.explanation: Good guess, friend, because taxes did come up in a test question on another day. That's Matthew 22:16-17, when the Pharisees send their disciples along with the Herodians to ask whether it's lawful to pay the census tax to Caesar, the Roman emperor. Here in chapter 19, though, the test is about divorce. The question is whether a man may divorce his wife for any reason (Matthew 19:3).
